steel.warning: Steel machining requires flood coolant to prevent tool wear and maintain surface finish.

stainless.warning: CRITICAL: Stainless steel work hardens. High-pressure flood coolant essential.

aluminum.warning: Aluminum machining benefits from flood coolant for chip evacuation.

titanium.warning: CRITICAL: Titanium generates extreme heat. High-pressure coolant through spindle required.

superalloy.warning: CRITICAL: Superalloys require high-pressure through-spindle coolant. Tool life severely affected without it.

cast_iron.warning: Cast iron can be machined dry. Use mist coolant for improved tool life.

plastic.warning: WARNING: Avoid flood coolant on plastics. Use air blast or dry machining.
plastic.floodWarning: Flood coolant may damage plastic materials or cause cracking

composite.warning: WARNING: Composites require vacuum extraction for dust. Avoid liquid coolants.
composite.healthWarning: Composite dust is hazardous. Use proper extraction and PPE.

PRISM_CNC_SAFETY_DATABASE.name: CNC Safety Database

awareness.toolContact: Contact with spinning tool = serious injury
conductRules: Know hand positions at all times

prohibited.gloves: No gloves except latex (can catch in spindle)
prohibited.clothing: No loose clothing, short sleeves preferred
prohibited.hair: Long hair must be tied back

generalRules: Use paint brush for chips (never hands or air hose)
Keep work area clean and organized

toolHandling: Never grip by flutes (sharp cutting edges)
Align dogs with slots when loading

troubleshooting.alternative: Sometimes decrease speed and increase feed is better
